page_geometry.root_cause: Canva PPTX sldSz is 810x1012 pt while the direct raster references use a 4:5 canvas. UnifiedImportPipeline._pptx preserves the PPTX aspect ratio when normalizing width to 1080; render_png then rounds the already-short scene height. The one-pixel delta exists before QImage creation.

layers_evidence.notes: The first six source objects materially overlap. Freeform 6 exceeds the entire reference canvas, so any stacking/group-composition semantic difference affects a large contiguous area. G2 reconstructs group parentage but production rendering orders all non-GROUP nodes globally by (z_index,id), rather than painting isolated group stacks. Pixel-level mismatch coordinates require the persisted diff artifacts; this entry records the exact source regions at risk without claiming unobserved pixels.

crop_evidence.notes: The image is expanded far beyond the shape before clipping; this is stretch/fillRect semantics, not srcRect source cropping.

mask_evidence.import_semantics: shape_geometry_metadata preserves only a conservative geometry label/radius approximation for custGeom. UnifiedImportPipeline._pptx_element does not carry custom geometry into image nodes. qt_renderer._draw_image only applies non-rectangular clipping when node.metadata.clip_path exists. No correction is applied in this audit.
mask_evidence.interpretation: This is a concrete systemic candidate for the measured MASK contribution: Canva picture-filled custom freeforms can lose their exact mask path and fall back to the rectangular image target/fillRect clip.

official_png.search_notes: Library/conversation PNG candidates were screenshots, UI captures, generated images or unrelated assets. Downloads(1)(1).zip and Downloads(2)(1).zip contain PPTX sources but no standalone PNG/JPEG exports. No JPEG was converted to PNG.
